acceptance_text: Make "Preliminary estimating only - final engineering required" persistent on generated structural concepts, client estimate notes as appropriate, and handoff exports. (ESTIMATOR_MASTERPLAN.md:714; canonical string uses the ASCII hyphen form exactly as written there.)

surface_map.concept_surface: FoundationSectionBanner.jsx mounts <PreliminaryNotice/> as a SIBLING of the collapsible explainer — 'Collapse Section' toggles only the section text; the notice stays rendered while the page is mounted. Non-dismissible = persistent per concept on-screen.
surface_map.client_estimate_notes: FoundationProject.notes (entity field {"type":"string"}) is the module's client-notes channel: it is persisted by the page payload, carried verbatim by save-as-copy, browser drafts, and template snapshots, and is the text a staff member copies into estimate notes / sees on the record. Two authoring paths stamp the preamble: (a) template notes on BOTH snapshot (stored template carries it at rest) and apply (pre-change/external templates covered) — stampTemplateNotesNotice, mirroring the O-007t stampTemplateAppliedAiData fail-closed/idempotent pattern; (b) convertFoundationToBrickStone wraps its authored note with ensurePreliminaryNotice. apply never injects notes when the template omits the key (absent keys preserve the target's own notes).
surface_map.handoff_exports: Shared constant + component exported so owned-elsewhere surfaces adopt with one line: FoundationBOM.jsx print block (Phase B-3 owns), page notes mounts (FoundationEstimator.jsx), and handoff text builders (estimateConversionService generatedDescription consumes Estimate.notes — stamping foundation notes keeps the sentence available to that chain). Deferred as documented wiring remainders — NOT landed here (file ownership).
surface_map.ai_review_channel_checked_not_touched: foundationAiReview.js already self-labels: prompt requires 'clearly label it preliminary', stored ai_engineering_data carries review_status:'preliminary_only' + engineering_approved:false, and AiEngineeringAssistant renders 'AI Preliminary Review' + the O-007t guaranteed-stale banner. Stamping the canonical sentence INTO ai_engineering_recommendation markdown was rejected — it would interleave non-AI text into AI-authored content; the UI banner + notes stamps cover persistence.

ledger_paragraph: O-119 (CMP-I18) preliminary-notice unit LOCAL-ONLY at remote HEAD 8b0fcf921 (clean worktree; all baselines fresh sandbox reads — never local src/). New foundationPreliminaryNotice.js is the shared source of truth: PRELIMINARY_NOTICE_TEXT (verbatim acceptance sentence), hasPreliminaryNotice, idempotent+fail-closed ensurePreliminaryNotice, and the PreliminaryNotice component (role='status' always, never role='alert'; dismissible is opt-in per-view via useState). Three adoptions landed as candidates: foundationTemplateModel stamps template-authored notes on BOTH snapshot and apply (stampTemplateNotesNotice mirrors the O-007t provenance-stamp pattern — absent stays absent so a target's own notes are never clobbered, null travels, malformed fails closed); FoundationSectionBanner mounts the notice as a collapse-proof sibling (persistent per concept, zero page edits); convertToBrickStone stamps its authored notes so the converted masonry concept carries it. FoundationTemplateDialog gains display-only disclosure (save-mode preamble note) + a carried-notes row indicator. Deferred by file ownership, documented in-file: FoundationBOM print mount + any future page notes mount adopt via one-line <PreliminaryNotice/>. Verified: 17/17 esbuild+react-test-renderer cases on candidates + 8/8 real-Chromium browser cases at 1280px/390px (collapse persistence, per-view dismiss, zero foreign requests/console/page errors; screenshots). AI-review channel left verbatim — it already self-labels preliminary_only; stamping AI-authored markdown was rejected. Not touched: FoundationEstimator.jsx, FoundationBOM.jsx, foundationCalc/foundationReinforcement*/partSync (Phase B-3), FoundationProject.jsonc/FoundationSettings.jsx (O-104), foundationAiReview, entities.
